**Synopsis:**
Record UK heatwaves have produced a bumper berry harvest (+6% YoY), aided by polytunnel farming and drip irrigation. However, the same heat has severely damaged cereals (wheat -13% vs 5yr avg; spring barley near record lows since 1999). Water stress is a growing structural risk: ~40% of berry growers lack independent water storage. Long-term, climate change is expected to entrench hot, dry summers and wetter winters in the UK, with competing supply regions (Spain, N. Africa) facing even greater heat/drought stress.
